patch.value: Explain incompatible joint decision proposals before apply
Validate selected typed answers against caller-declared cross-question constraints and host relationship rules without changing model answers or tracker state.

A mutually exclusive classification pair produces a two-answer witness; validator never silently edits model answers; a failed constraint produces zero mutations; typed SDK and CLI with compact TOON/JSON, typed refusals and remedies; documented example and measured public tracker validation.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck: index.ts parseQuestionsDocument/validateAnswers validate individual typed shapes; triage/link apply individual proposals. Installed host SDK graph exports RelationshipGraph, assertHierarchyMutationAllowed, assertNonHierarchyCardinalityMutationAllowed, validateRelationshipEvents and ordering analysis; core owns mutation validation/transactions. Sibling pm-context next-evidence/witnesses select evidence, pm-review scopes validate review obligations, pm-rl handles evaluation/training; none implements caller-declared cross-question answer constraints. Plan: bounded read-only joint validation with exact choice/score/noul predicates, mutually exclusive/implication rules, compact answer witnesses and host graph checks for conditional relationship additions. No new apply, import/export/sync, journal, lease, checkpoint or status classification path; no model calls or tracker writes. Acceptance and shared safety constraints recorded before implementation.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation: exported joint schema, validator and compact typed reports; jev validate delegates to the same SDK path. Selected choice/score values are preserved even when distributions disagree; noul predicates require exact inclusive cutoffs. Relationship additions are checked as one prospective graph via SDK edge, hierarchy, cardinality and ordering primitives. The new path is read-only and has no persistent package state. Focused tests currently pass 7/7, including 500 seeded sequences / 4000 operations, native no-Git JSON/TOON and SDK read-back preservation. Shipped SDK producer optional fields are accepted; malformed inputs are refused before client acquisition. Additional branch coverage and installation/public-copy acceptance are running.

Aggregate provenance and limitations are in docs/joint-decisions-evidence.json. value.text: Resumed for PR 65 auto re-review round 1. Worktree is clean; origin/main is fully contained in this branch (two commits ahead, zero behind), so no merge is needed. General rule: propagate the same caller/workspace relationship registry through construction, integrity checks and every derived graph analysis; never reconstruct custom semantics with a built-in default. Auditing other commands, SDK/CLI, serializers, tests and packed consumers for the same class; the supplied review names one blocking finding, and additional posted findings are being checked. Existing completed feature work and evidence are retained.
